gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed IDH wild type (primary) GBM. Molecular GBM (as per cIMPACT-NOW 3) is allowed as is gliosarcoma and epithelioid glioblastoma. IDH-mutant glioma is not allowed.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Sacituzumab govitecan: Dosing will be at 10 mg/kg on days 1 and 8 of a 21-day cycle (interventions: Drug: Sacituzumab Govitecan)

role_evidence.quote: This is an open-label single arm study. All patients will receive the study drug.

source_quote.quote: Positive Trop-2 expression (H-Score ≥200), as verified by central review at University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio (UTHSA).
Histologically confirmed IDH wild type (primary) GBM.

coder_notes: MGMT status appears only in prior-therapy history (temozolomide required if MGMT methylated); not an entry biomarker, not listed. Lomustine mentioned only as historical control, not an intervention. Trop-2 is the target of sacituzumab govitecan.
